50e9a347.text:
Welcome back, $N. 

I understand all too well the shock that one feels when finding themselves in the situation you now find yourself in. The fact that you have made it this far sets you apart from many other newly risen paladins.

You will find that the hardest part about your new life will be in rediscovering what you lost in life...and enduring the pain it causes you.

Speak with me in Deathknell, and I will help you find the resolve to take your first steps.

-Aramis Hammerhand, $C Trainer
50e9a347.title: Consecrated Scroll

10266|6e63d362.name: Ug'thok
10266|6e63d362.text: You learn quickly, that is not a bad thing. Just be sure to do the job right, as long as it takes to do so. Now, I fear I must send you to Snarl to learn more. Learn what he can teach, but do not listen to his angry words. He gets that way when Saru's daughters laugh at him.

10266|b17b8494.name: Ug'thok
10266|b17b8494.text: I can show you what you wish to know, but you must be patient. Take your time to work the steel and feel the way it shapes beneath your hammer. When you become one with the steel, then you will understand.

10666|43217733.name: Gordo
10666|43217733.text: Us is busy with important things!

10666|5f4181c7.name: Gordo
10666|5f4181c7.text: Oh yeah. Us gots it right here.

11017|788cf9fc.name: Roxxik
11017|788cf9fc.text: Nice try, but you'll need some more experience before training with me! Back to the trenches!

11868|48da0bbc.name: Sayoc
11868|48da0bbc.text: Here to learn how to wield a new weapon, or just to waste my time?

11868|a3056c62.name: Sayoc
11868|a3056c62.text:
Ansekhwa, the tauren weapon master, is on Thunder Bluff's lower rise.  He can train one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.

Hanashi, standing next to me here, can instruct in the use of bows, one and two-handed axes, staves and all manner of thrown weapons.

Archibald, the $r weapon master in the War Quarter of the Undercity, can teach the use of crossbows, daggers, one and two-handed swords and polearms.

14720|a61382af.name: High Overlord Saurfang
14720|a61382af.text: I am he that watches they. I am the fist of retribution. That which does quell the recalcitrant. Dare you defy the Warchief? Dare you face my merciless judgement?

14726|65d66388.name: Rashona Straglash
14726|65d66388.text:
In these trying times, a simple donation of cloth can go a long way to help those less fortunate than ourselves.  Cloth goes a long way to making garments and bandages - both important for the war effort!

If you are interested in donating cloth pieces to the orcs of Orgrimmar, I will gladly accept them and make sure you receive the proper recognition for doing so.

For the Horde!

1495|54c6960c.name: Deathguard Linnea
1495|54c6960c.text: Greetings, $C. Be wary as you travel east toward The Bulwark. Recent surveillance reports indicate increased Scourge activity in that area, so exercise caution.

1496|3ccea7ef.name: Deathguard Dillinger
1496|3ccea7ef.text: Blacksmith?  Nope, our last one turned back into one of those mindless Scourge.  There's one in the Undercity though to the south of town though.  Undercity is underneath the Ruins of Lordaeron, clever name, huh?  Just take the elevators down at the back of the ruins and then you can talk to one of the Undercity Guardians.  They should be able to point you in the right direction.

1496|54d7bdcd.name: Deathguard Dillinger
1496|54d7bdcd.text: Take it, then. It seems Zygand is too busy for the agonizing trip here to retrieve it himself.

1496|ccfca24c.name: Deathguard Dillinger
1496|ccfca24c.text: If you're willing to risk yourself over the Light, then you can speak with Shari Stilwell near the stables. She can entertain your insanity.

1496|d821d003.name: Deathguard Dillinger
1496|d821d003.text: Sorry friend, we don't have one of those here in Brill.  You'll have to head to the Undercity for that.  The Undercity is underneath the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south of Brill.  From the back of the ruins take the elevator down and then speak to one of the Undercity Guardians to find your way further.

1499|9cb5b422.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499|9cb5b422.text: Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

15354|658164d5.name: Rachelle Gothena
15354|658164d5.text: Happy Hallow's End!  How do you like my mask?  Very scary!

1569|e2fc85be.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
1569|e2fc85be.text: No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.

1652|ccfca24c.name: Deathguard Burgess
1652|ccfca24c.text: If you're willing to risk yourself over the Light, then you can speak with Shari Stilwell near the stables. She can entertain your insanity.

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

223|43871080.name: Dan Golthas
223|43871080.text: I can't help you; your work is beyond my own. Talk to Arthur Moore, over there by the coffins. He'll be able to train you further.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

244808|3f8410df.name: Aramis Hammerhand
244808|3f8410df.text: Welcome back to the light, friend. Do you require training?

246143|0c0fbd1e.name: Frightened Paladin
246143|0c0fbd1e.text:
No! No, no, no! This can't be. I'd rather be dead than Forsaken! 

<The Frightened $C raises her weapon, preparing to attack!>

246152|8754b3a4.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|8754b3a4.text: The light is a beacon that shines for all. What can I do for you, $c?

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do. Would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

247229|83e0509a.name: Daniel
247229|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

247229|b3334d4d.name: Daniel
247229|b3334d4d.text:
Of course! Which profession would you like me to guide you towards?

I will mark your map with the location of a local trainer of your choice. Remember that you can visit trainers in capital cities for more thorough training.

248415|bdfaa98c.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

251001|379c835f.name: Deathguard Kristof
251001|379c835f.text:
Please do see that he reads it at once. I fear our Scourge problem has only just begun.

Come see me again in due time. I believe I have nearly uncovered something I could use a willing blade to help with.

256386|6a190ff9.name: Dokimi
256386|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

260093|58279558.name: Garen Largo
260093|58279558.text: Do you require training in the ways of the light?

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

265944|b48f927f.name: William Pickman
265944|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

2704|15da2919.name: Hanashi
2704|15da2919.text: Heya mon.  You come right place learn how ta wield a new weapon.

2704|4dcaabe3.name: Hanashi
2704|4dcaabe3.text:
Ansekhwa, da tauren weapon master, is on da Thunder Bluff lower rise.  He teach one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.

Archibald, da $r weapon master in da War Quarter of da Undercity, train good with crossbows, daggers, one and two-handed swords and polearms.

Sayoc, da ugly orc right here, can teach da ways of bows, daggers, fist weapons, one and two-handed axes and thrown weapons mon.

2855|8f48a40a.name: Snang
2855|8f48a40a.text: I know a few things, but I'm no expert. Lucky for you, Magar is. He's standing near the back of the shop. See if he can help you, but be careful not to rile him. He can be irritable.

2857|31f4573e.name: Thund
2857|31f4573e.text: You know who's really smart? Nogg! Smarter than me, even. You go tell Nogg Thund sent you! You can find him by the control panel over there.

2857|6139c96a.name: Thund
2857|6139c96a.text: Who says Orcs aren't smart? It takes a lot of brains to be an engineer!

2857|829e343d.name: Thund
2857|829e343d.text: You think you're smart enough? You think you got what it takes? Let's find out!

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3296|2213d915.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|2213d915.text: Talk to Saru Steelfury at The Burning Anvil.  Go to the Valley of Honor.  It's at the end of the path to the right of Red Canyon Mining.

3296|3bc2ba16.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|3bc2ba16.text: The Orgrimmar Auction House is in the Valley of Strength.  Look for it on the east side next to Boomstick Imports.

3296|66e82c80.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|66e82c80.text: Look for Nogg's Machine Shop in the Valley of Honor northeast of Red Canyon Mining.

3296|8a2104a1.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|8a2104a1.text: Clothing!?  That won't help you against good steel!  Bah, if you're sure you want to be a tailor go find Magar's Cloth Goods in The Drag.

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3355|9ce36f55.name: Saru Steelfury
3355|9ce36f55.text: This isn't a game you toy with youngling! Go, speak with Snarl outside. He may be a serpent in my lair but he does know his way around an anvil.

3363|05c29513.name: Magar
3363|05c29513.text: About time you showed me some results! Now I'll show you results!

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3412|d0fc10c2.name: Nogg
3412|d0fc10c2.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

3412|fe9433e2.name: Nogg
3412|fe9433e2.text: Every day is a test, and this day is no different. If you pass this test, I will share some of my knowledge...

3413|c879b3f9.name: Sovik
3413|c879b3f9.text: Hello, $N! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3483|aa3c8600.name: Jahan Hawkwing
3483|aa3c8600.text: The Barrens, with its hot sun and hostile denizens, is the perfect place to test your strength and fortitude.

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4485|21cdc0a3.name: Belgrom Rockmaul
4485|21cdc0a3.text: The days grow long, and still no end to the conflicts of these lands can be seen. It takes no spell caster to know that much. Take up a blade while you can, $c. War can come to our doors at any time, and if I'm not mistaken, you look to be one who revels in it.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4582|08830bac.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

4582|0deb5cc3.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|0deb5cc3.text: With the sanction of Lord Varimathras, the Deathstalkers' numbers grow. More blades to strike at our enemies when they least expect it.

4588|8c2f02e7.name: Arthur Moore
4588|8c2f02e7.text: I'm pleased to say that your talents have outpaced my own. Go away now. Err, try the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. She's very skilled, I assure you.

4596|60f0c131.name: James Van Brunt
4596|60f0c131.text: You waste my time, go talk with my student Basil.

4605|1690954e.name: Basil Frye
4605|1690954e.text: I hope to one day forge weapons and armor from the bones of my enemies.

4605|3a5f002e.name: Basil Frye
4605|3a5f002e.text: You are not trying to kill the anvil with your hammer, you are trying to create a weapon to kill your foes with. Let me show you what you are doing wrong.

5624|00d342d3.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|00d342d3.text: James Van Brunt in War Quarter on inner ring.

5624|ad0caf45.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|ad0caf45.text: Him's at inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.

5624|dd3eed63.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|dd3eed63.text: We not so sure paladins safe to touch, but they at War Quarter in big building.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5819|88989ac8.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|88989ac8.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

8359|6fec0ef7.name: Ahanu
8359|6fec0ef7.text: Greetings.  If you are here for leather goods, then you will find my wares well crafted.

911|7a171557.name: Llane Beshere
911|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the $r race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

1145-progress.name: Belgrom Rockmaul
1145-progress.text:
I envy you, $c. You have the look of someone who's been outside the walls of Orgrimmar for a while.

I myself would travel in the name of the Warchief if Thrall didn't have need of my skills here in the city. But he leads us well, and I trust his judgement--I remain here for as long as he needs me.
1145-progress.title: The Swarm Grows

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

3100-progress.name: Llane Beshere
3100-progress.text:
Ah, you got my letter, $N... good.

There's been an influx of warriors in Elwynn recently--which is good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and Defias in the area.
3100-progress.title: Simple Letter

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

358-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
358-progress.title: Graverobbers

365-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-progress.text: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents.  Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
365-progress.title: Fields of Grief

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

375-progress.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?
375-progress.title: The Chill of Death

376-progress.name: Novice Elreth
376-progress.text: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
376-progress.title: The Damned

381-progress.name: Executor Arren
381-progress.text: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
381-progress.title: The Scarlet Crusade

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

407-progress.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
407-progress.title: Fields of Grief

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

5481-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-progress.text: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
5481-progress.title: Gordo's Task

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6361-progress.name: Devrak
6361-progress.text: Are you here for a wind rider?  You have something to transport?
6361-progress.title: A Bundle of Hides

6362-progress.name: Ahanu
6362-progress.text: There is dust on your shoulders that must be from the Barrens.  You have spoken with my friend Jahan?
6362-progress.title: Ride to Thunder Bluff

6363-progress.name: Tal
6363-progress.text: Greetings, $c.  What can I do for you?
6363-progress.title: Tal the Wind Rider Master

6364-progress.name: Jahan Hawkwing
6364-progress.text: $N, you are back from Thunder Bluff?  Did you deliver the hides to Ahanu?
6364-progress.title: Return to Jahan

8-progress.name: Innkeeper Renee
8-progress.text:
Yes? Yes? What is it?

The forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
8-progress.title: A Rogue's Deal

90902-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-accept.text:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen $c to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902-accept.title: Rediscovering the Light

90902-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-complete.text:
Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances. 

Be well and walk in the light once more, $c.
90902-complete.title: Rediscovering the Light

91208-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91208-accept.text:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened $c who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
91208-accept.title: Coming to Terms

91209-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91209-accept.text:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a $c traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
91209-accept.title: Continue Your Training

91209-complete.name: Shari Stilwell
91209-complete.text:
Welcome aboard, $c. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training. 

When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.

Go with the light, $c.
91209-complete.title: Continue Your Training

91282-accept.name: Shari Stilwell
91282-accept.text:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new $c order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282-accept.title: A Second Home

91736-progress.name: Unknown
91736-progress.text: A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.
91736-progress.title: Applejack Still

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

96658-progress.name: William Pickman
96658-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96658-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

98601-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
98601-accept.text:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a $c like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
98601-accept.title: A Difficult Path

98601-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98601-complete.text: Your training can now begin in earnest, $c. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.
98601-complete.title: A Difficult Path

99141-progress.name: Executor Zygand
99141-progress.text: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
99141-progress.title: Patience

99144-accept.name: Bareth Dawnstone
99144-accept.text:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all we stand for!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

Our ranks are thin. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144-accept.title: Seeking Refuge
